name: notion-docs
description: Write feature documentation for Notion that people can read through: a short page per feature with scripted browser clips recorded as looping GIFs that show what to click and what happens. The bundled recorder drives Playwright, draws a cursor, click ripple, highlight ring, and captions over the real UI, and encodes the GIF itself. Pages publish through the Notion MCP file-upload flow when it is connected, or land as a local bundle to drag in.
